protocol.policy: leave-one-domain-out: train on every source domain, select on pooled source validation, evaluate on the held-out domain with no adaptation

fold_membership.train: union of each source domain's stage-2 train partition
fold_membership.val: union of each source domain's stage-2 val partition
fold_membership.test: the held-out domain's stage-2 test partition

protocol.source_test_rationale: Every sample keeps one project-wide role. Excluding source test keeps each domain's per-domain training volume identical between stage 2 and stage 3, so the in-domain versus cross-domain gap is not confounded by data volume, and it preserves untouched source test sets for a later source-retention analysis.
protocol.held_out_test_rationale: Evaluating on the held-out domain's stage-2 test partition rather than its whole pool keeps the cross-domain number on the same images as the stage-2 in-domain number, so the gap table is paired.

drishti_gs.note: provider_partition locks the 51-image provider test set and splits the 50-image provider training partition into 40 train / 10 val; test_fraction does not apply.

rim_one_dl.note: load_rim_one_dl_split_manifest is authoritative; the committed 70/10/20 manifest fixes membership and no fraction or seed in this file affects it.
